label: Crossing the analog-digital boundary
subgoals: Place an A-to-D module with hysteresis where analog drives digital
Place a D-to-A source with finite slope and impedance where digital drives analog
Treat interface parameters as part of the model

label: Synchronizing two engines
subgoals: Turn digital events into analog breakpoints
Locate analog threshold crossings and notify the digital side at that time
Choose lockstep for strong coupling and relaxation for weak coupling

label: Co-simulation architectures
subgoals: Locate the dominant runtime between the two engines
Replace slow analog blocks by real-number models where fidelity allows
Compare interface thresholds first when event timing disagrees
